pages.text: $(thing)Create: Wizardry$() makes mana a Create fluid. It needs Iron's Spells, and adds machines to extract, pipe and use mana. Pipe it like water, but mind the leaks.

pages.title: Mana Siphon
pages.text: Draws mana from players, spells and mobs. Placed above it, a crystalline block can crystallize mana into Arcane Essence. Drained arcane ingots never turn into netherite here.

pages.title: Arcane Pipe
pages.text: Carries mana. Un-insulated pipes rapidly leak it. Insulate with Arcane Sheets.

pages.title: Arcane Pump
pages.text: Made from an Arcane Pipe and a cogwheel. Moves mana by rotation, like a Mechanical Pump.

pages.title: Arcane Casing
pages.text: The casing for the mod's machines. See Casings in the Create entries.

pages.title: Channeler
pages.text: Harvests Liquid Lightning from lightning bolts. Takes a Bottle of Lightning from Iron's Spells.

pages.title: Blaze Caster
pages.text: A contraption that casts scroll spells. Must be superheated. Works in Impulse or Sentry modes.
The Blaze Caster holds a scroll and casts it using mana. Not every spell is compatible with it. Heat is Create's: see $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l) and a blaze burner.

Other fluids: Liquid Lightning, Blood (from compressing meat or boiling mobs), Fire Ale and Netherward Tincture. Several are made by Create $(l:create_basics/processing)processing$(/l) such as mixing; look recipes up in JEI. Back to $(l:exploration/magic)Magic$(/l).
